messages:
marie: heads-up: found API keys leaking in logs from examples/cli. when validation fails we dump resolved config which contains API key. reproducible and visible in staging Sentry.
samir: oof. which example + cli version?
marie: examples/quickstart-chat v1.4, cli 0.9.2. repro:
```
$ export RW_API_KEY=sk-test-abc123
$ export RW_ORG=acme-inc
$ node examples/quickstart-chat/index.js --env prod
Error: project missing
  at init (/app/index.js:58)
Config: { org: "acme-inc", project: undefined, apiKey: "sk-test-abc123" }
```
marie: same dump in staging Sentry.
kevin: immediate fix: redact known secret fields in logger by default. add opt-in `--expose-config` for local use only. i'll take CLI change (P0).
tia: propose auto-redact fields ["apiKey", "token", "secret", "privateKey"], and show `<redacted>` for structured logs. add `redacted_fields` array to payloads.
samir: i'll patch SDK logger to redact and avoid printing full config in error handlers (P0).
marie: naming chaos: RW_API_KEY, RW_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY. suggestion: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT and accept legacy envs with a 90-day warning.
kevin: ok on canonical names. also recommend `rw auth login` for ephemeral creds and document rotation.
deploy-bot: created issue RW-2345: "Redact keys in logs + canonical env vars" https://tracker.internal/RW-2345
kevin: will open CLI PR in ~48h and add changelog note. samir: will open SDK PR. marie: please message support to rotate staging keys and add emergency rotation snippet to infra playbooks. thanks all :rocket:
